name: design-qa
description: Headless responsive UI review across breakpoints, themes, a11y, Core Web Vitals, SEO, and visual regression. Built for Vercel preview deploys.

vercelBypassSecret.description: Vercel Protection Bypass for Automation secret. Used as x-vercel-protection-bypass header to access protected preview deploys.

argosToken.description: Argos CI token for visual regression baselines. Get from argos-ci.com.

browserDriver.description: Browser driver. 'playwright-mcp' (default) uses Microsoft Playwright MCP. 'agent-browser' uses Vercel agent-browser CLI for token-efficient runs and real Mobile Safari.

breakpointPreset.description: Breakpoint matrix to sweep. 'fast' = 5 widths. 'agency-default' = 18 widths covering grey areas. 'thorough' = 18 widths + ultra-wide + foldable outer + landscape.

reviewerConfigPath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the reviewer persona config. Defaults to .claude/design-qa/reviewer.json.

authStrategy.description: How the QA agent authenticates to protected app routes.

argosUploadOnReview.description: Auto-upload screenshots to Argos at the end of /design-qa:review. Requires argosToken.
